skills: Rapid domain orientation: getting functional knowledge of a new niche fast enough to be useful
Cross-domain pattern matching: applying frameworks and best practices from one field to problems in another
Emerging role identification: recognizing when a recurring need deserves its own specialist
Life admin systematization: the unglamorous logistics of running a household, managing personal records, maintaining subscriptions
Personal sustainability: routines, habits, and systems that prevent burnout and maintain baseline functioning
Research synthesis: pulling together information from multiple sources into actionable recommendations
Triage and routing: figuring out which specialist a problem actually needs and framing the handoff well
Gap analysis: identifying what's falling through the cracks between existing roles and systems
